pictures.name: PQ1-Calculator
pictures.prompt: France in the early 1640s, a candlelit study in an old stone house. Blaise Pascal, a thin young man of nineteen with long wavy brown hair to his shoulders, in a dark doublet with a plain white collar, bends over a gleaming brass calculating machine of small dials and gears on a wooden desk covered with ledgers and tax papers. Behind him his father, an older man with a grey beard in black lawyer’s robes, watches with quiet pride. Warm candlelight, deep blue shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
